name: io.github.tonyyang0504/temu_seller-mcp
description: Temu Seller Center (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, get_order. Every tool maps

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_SELLER_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: app_key of your TEMU Partner Platform app (partner.temu.com > App management).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_SELLER_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: app_secret of the same app; signs every call (upper-case MD5 of app_secret + body parameters sorted by name as name+value + app_secret) and is never sent.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_SELLER_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The store's access_token from the Seller Center authorisation (Seller Center > open platform > authorise app, or bg.open.accesstoken.create with the callback code); valid about one year (see expiredTime from me).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TEMU_SELLER_REGION
environmentVariables.description: API host region of the store: us (United States), eu (EU/UK sites) or global (Mexico, Japan, …) → https://openapi-b-<region>.temu.com/openapi/router.
